## Summary
<sup>What this changes and why. Skip what CI already reports (test counts, build status).</sup>

## Upstream source
<sup>For each format this touches: the emulator source it comes from, with file and commit or tag. "None" if no format changes.</sup>

## Units and RomM
<sup>Does this add or change what a unit holds or how it's named? If so, how the old shape still restores, and what RomM needs to change (link the RomM PR). "No change" is a claim reviewers will check.</sup>

## Known losses
<sup>Anything that doesn't round-trip, or doesn't write what the target emulator writes. These also go under Open items on the platform page.</sup>

## Testing evidence
<sup>Emulators and versions, the real saves used (manifest rows), what each game showed after crossing, and what you broke on purpose to see the new tests fail.</sup>

## AI assistance
<sup>What role AI played, and how much (e.g. "written primarily by Claude Code", "none").</sup>
